items.source: Instantiates a target handler through a Spring BeanFactory and also provides an equivalent destroy method.
items.translation: 通过 Spring BeanFactory 实例化目标处理器，并提供等效的销毁方法。

items.source: An exception handling WebSocketHandlerDecorator.
items.translation: 异常处理WebSocketHandlerDecorator。

items.source: A WebSocketHandler that initializes and destroys a WebSocketHandler instance for each WebSocket connection and delegates all other methods to it.
items.translation: 一个WebSocketHandler，它为每个 WebSocket 连接初始化并销毁一个WebSocketHandler实例，并将所有其他方法委托给它。

items.source: Convenient WebSocketHandler implementations and decorators.
items.translation: 方便的WebSocketHandler实现和装饰器。

items.source: A convenient base class for WebSocketHandler implementation with empty methods.
items.translation: 一个方便的基类，用于实现带有空方法的WebSocketHandler。

items.source: A convenient base class for WebSocketHandler implementations that process binary messages only.
items.translation: 一个方便的基础类，用于仅处理二进制消息的WebSocketHandler实现。

items.source: Wrap a WebSocketSession to guarantee only one thread can send messages at a time.
items.translation: 将 `WebSocketSession` 包装起来，以确保同一时间只有一个线程可以发送消息。

items.source: A WebSocketHandlerDecorator that adds logging to WebSocket lifecycle events.
items.translation: 一个用于为 WebSocket 生命周期事件添加日志的WebSocketHandlerDecorator。

items.source: A convenient base class for WebSocketHandler implementations that process text messages only.
items.translation: 一个方便的基础类，用于仅处理文本消息的WebSocketHandler实现。

items.source: Wraps another WebSocketHandler instance and delegates to it.
items.translation: 封装另一个 `WebSocketHandler` 实例并委托给它。

items.source: Wraps another WebSocketSession instance and delegates to it.
items.translation: 封装另一个 `WebSocketSession` 实例并委托给它。

items.source: Common abstractions and Spring configuration support for WebSocket applications.
items.translation: WebSocket 应用的通用抽象和 Spring 配置支持。

items.source: Enum for options of what to do when the buffer fills up.
items.translation: 用于在缓冲区填满时采取行动的选项枚举。

items.source:
Raised when a WebSocket session has exceeded limits it has been configured
for, for example, timeout, buffer size, etc.
items.translation: 当 WebSocket 会话超过其配置的限值（例如超时、缓冲区大小等）时抛出。

items.source: A factory for applying decorators to a WebSocketHandler.
items.translation: 用于向 WebSocketHandler 应用装饰器的工厂。
